criteria.automated_scope: CONTAINER checks pins, digest, checksum and open-spec fields from source; the real image build runs in the Development environment workflow.

criteria.intent: One setup/build/check/serve/doctor entry delegating to the existing locked owners.
criteria.automated_scope: CONTAINER verifies the exact delegated plans; execution inside the image is the workflow run.

criteria.intent: CI builds the same Containerfile and runs doctor, setup and check inside it.
criteria.automated_scope: WORKFLOW verifies the workflow shape; only an actual run on the PR head proves it.

criteria.intent: Vendor-neutral AI entry with AGENTS.md as router.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY verifies wording and the guide link; usefulness needs review.

criteria.intent: Browser-only workflow on interchangeable hosts and hosting as a replaceable adapter.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY verifies named hosts and adapter owners; the iPad trial is external.

criteria.intent: Registries, RI, layout, format and CS01/CS04/CS05 stay green.

REVIEW.description: Independent nonauthor code/white-box review of the exact PR head with recorded findings and dispositions.

CI-RUN.description: Development environment workflow passes on the exact PR head.

CONTROL.description: Maintainer accepts the new workflow and tools/quality control changes and decides the merge.

DEVICE.description: Maintainer opens the environment on a devcontainer host from the iPad and reports the result.
